data.gender_notes: Bujaybah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Bujaybah is derived from the Arabic word 'Bujthah' which means patience, endurance, steadfastness. This name is mentioned in the Quran as the name of a noblewoman who was known for her unwavering patience and steadfastness during times of hardship and trial. The name Bujaybah carries the meaning “Patient, Enduring, Steadfast” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bujaybah usually hope their child will grow to embody patient, enduring, steadfast and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bujaybah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
